subject.title: [Feature]: /learn command — distill recent work into a reviewable skill draft

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `/learn` chat command as a thin wrapper around the existing Skill Workshop proposal flow?
rationale: The request is plausible and aligned with ergonomics, but it adds a new core command across channel surfaces and sits near the VISION.md boundary between lean core, skills, and ClawHub.

options.title: Approve thin core command
options.body: Add `/learn` as a built-in chat command that sends a standards-guided normal agent turn into Skill Workshop proposal creation while preserving human approval and scanner gates.

options.title: Document existing workflow
options.body: Keep core unchanged and improve docs/help for asking the agent or CLI to create a Skill Workshop proposal from recent work.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Require a plugin or ClawHub-packaged affordance if maintainers do not want another built-in command surface.

recommendation.title: Approve thin core command
recommendation.body: Add `/learn` as a built-in chat command that sends a standards-guided normal agent turn into Skill Workshop proposal creation while preserving human approval and scanner gates.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Skill Workshop/command registry surface and opened the protected maintainer-labeled request.
